, an e-commerce platform redefining how premium furniture is designed, priced, and delivered. NoLogo eliminates retail and brand markups by leveraging AI, a digitally native supply chain, and direct-to-factory production, making high-end, custom furniture more accessible.
(CMO, co-founder and President of GR0), and AJ Jain (CTO, formerly of Opendoor and ThinkSys). Together, they aim to bring greater transparency and efficiency to the bloated home goods industry.
"Designer furniture today is priced like luxury fashion — inflated by brand premiums, showrooms, and outdated supply chains," said
, CEO of NoLogo. "We're flipping that model so consumers can access premium, custom-made furniture without paying for a logo."
Problem: Why NoLogo Exists
NoLogo was built to solve a common frustration: furniture prices often have more to do with branding than craftsmanship. Their research shows:
Consumers pay up to 70% more due to brand, retail, and marketing markups.
Dupe culture dominates social platforms (#dupe on TikTok has over 6 billion views), showcasing consumer demand for designer quality without the price.
94% of shoppers say they're more loyal to brands that break down how pricing works.
How It Works: Upload a Link. Get a Custom Product.
$25K in preorders in the first week post-launch, 50+ organic orders, 10K+ quotes generated through the quoting engine, MVP launched June 2025
DTC brands promised a fix, but most still offer generic designs with prices weighed down by inventory and ad spend.
is a DTC platform that uses AI to turn any product link into made-to-order furniture with faster delivery and no brand markup.

: By connecting customers directly to manufacturers, NoLogo strips out inventory, marketing, and brand costs, passing savings to the buyer.
